publication.empirical_boundary: Methods, architectures, and falsifiable evaluations are specified; unexecuted experiments are not represented as measured results.

papers.english_title: Three Forms, One Mind: A Triform Architecture for Persistent AI Products
papers.implementation_boundary: Cloud, desktop, and Edge are coordinated product bodies; source presence alone does not prove a live cloud deployment or distributable installer.

papers.english_title: The Persistent Cloud and the Intermittent Body
papers.implementation_boundary: The cloud may preserve identity, queues, and coordination while devices are offline; it may not claim local execution without returned evidence.

papers.english_title: Sovereign Computation as a Product Architecture
papers.implementation_boundary: Sovereignty is measured through local execution, exportability, replaceability, transparency, and recovery; it is not established by branding.

papers.english_title: Identity, Authority, and Boundaries in Multi-User Agent Systems
papers.implementation_boundary: Humans, organizations, agents, models, devices, API clients, and runtime cells are distinct principals; delegated authority must be attenuated and revocable.

papers.english_title: A Federation of Machines for User-Owned Agent Execution
papers.implementation_boundary: Paired devices advertise bounded capabilities and remain separate principals; federation is not unrestricted remote control.

papers.english_title: Agents Under Law: Governed Computer Access for Autonomous Systems
papers.implementation_boundary: Agents may discover, plan, and propose; consequential execution requires exact action-bound authority and post-action validation.

papers.english_title: Consensus from the Smallest: Hierarchical Atomic Models as Internal Cognitive Labor
papers.implementation_boundary: Atomic lanes, specialist identities, and council routing are architecture and runtime contracts until exact promoted checkpoints and evaluations exist.

papers.english_title: Living Memory and the Continuity of Artificial Identity
papers.implementation_boundary: Same-session recall is not durable memory, and a reused model name is not identity continuity; longitudinal evidence is required.

papers.english_title: Proof Before Assertion: Evidence-Native AI Operations
papers.implementation_boundary: Claims must be supported by the evidence class they require; local unkeyed hashes do not establish external custody.
Marketable capabilities require explicit permissions, versions, prices or quotas, evidence obligations, runtimes, and rollback behavior.

papers.english_title: Voice, Body, and Mind: Toward Native Conversational Embodiment
papers.implementation_boundary: A voice stack is not proven expressive or low-latency until exact model, hardware, consent, and benchmark evidence exists.

papers.english_title: A Commonwealth of Intelligences: The AI-Native Organization as a Living System
papers.implementation_boundary: Organizational intelligence must preserve human agency and distinguish proposals, approvals, executions, validations, and outcomes.

papers.english_title: Governed Emergence in Synthetic Cognitive Systems
papers.implementation_boundary: Emergence is an observed longitudinal property under bounded recurrence and consequence, not an anthropomorphic label or scripted role.
